title: Government Cabinet Room
purpose: Homepage 'Government' sector card and government-vertical surfaces.
story: A cabinet mid-deliberation around a great round table — the weight of collective decision, no single speaker dominating.
environment: A formal government cabinet room, panelled in dark wood, tall arched windows along one wall.
architecture: Classical statecraft interior — coffered ceiling, fluted pilasters, a carved cornice receding into shadow.

people.notes: A dozen figures seated, several seen from behind; no face dominant, no one addressing the camera.

composition: The round table on a strong central axis; figures subordinate to the room; deep negative space toward the ceiling.
continuityNotes: Establishes the set's grade: near-black walls, one warm source, gold brass accents. All other interiors must match this darkness and warmth.
